segmentation.text: other than in a marked crosswalk or within an unmarked crosswalk

elements.justification: 'Pedestrian' is admitted as the aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian ('a person afoot, a person in a manual or motorized wheelchair, or a person on an electric personal assistive mobility device'); ru.aggregate carries 'membership of a legal aggregate' and is claimed as one atom, never expanded into classes. Same words, same atoms as 'No pedestrian' in LVMC_11_30_050.

Same words, same mapping as LVMC_11_30_050. 'a roadway' (DEF-NRS-484A-220: 'that portion of a highway which is improved and ordinarily used for vehicular traffic, exclusive of the shoulder') is st.roadway, 'the part of a highway improved for vehicular traffic, excluding shoulder'; its exclusion (not the sidewalk) does not apply, since only the roadway is read. The pedestrian is on it by rel.occupies ('a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region'). 'cross' is motion across the designated direction of travel of a lane ('a longitudinal strip of roadway for one line of vehicles') or of the roadway the pedestrian occupies: drv.motion.moving_across_carrier ('Road user a moves across the designated direction of travel of carrier region r'); that concept says nothing of occupancy, so occupancy is read beside it. st.lane is not used as a half of the roadway or a lateral position, as its exclusion forbids: only as a carrier of a direction.

'a marked crosswalk or ... an unmarked crosswalk' (DEF-NRS-484A-065: '(1) That part of a highway at an intersection included within the connections of the lateral lines of the sidewalks ... or (2) Any portion of a highway at an intersection or elsewhere distinctly indicated for pedestrian crossing by lines or other markings on the surface') is st.crosswalk: 'marked crossing, or the unmarked prolongation of sidewalks at an intersection (st.intersection); marked attribute'. Both values of the marked attribute are admitted, so the definition's whole extent is kept. 'in' / 'within' is the footprint overlapping the crosswalk: rel.occupies. Same atoms as 'except in a crosswalk' (LVMC_11_30_050).

assumptions.meaning: the place of the road user at the observation lies in a business district, as the map's reading classifies the area

applicability: The subject is a pedestrian (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian) whose footprint overlaps a roadway (rel.occupies, st.roadway) at a place the reading declares to lie in a business district (asm.business_district), read at the judged observation.
obligation: At every observation at which the subject occupies a roadway and moves across a lane or roadway it occupies (drv.motion.moving_across_carrier with speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance and cos_max p.crossing_motion_cos, on a region of kind st.lane or st.roadway the subject occupies), the subject's footprint overlaps a crosswalk (rel.occupies, st.crosswalk, marked or unmarked). Moving across the roadway while occupying no crosswalk is violated; standing on the roadway or moving along it is not a crossing and is compliant here.

narrowings.why: 'cross a roadway' is read at each observation as moving across the designated direction of a lane or roadway the pedestrian occupies (more than p.crossing_motion_cos from it, faster than p.halt_speed_tolerance); a pedestrian standing on the roadway or walking along it is not crossing and is not judged by this rule (LVMC_11_30_090 judges walking along).

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A pedestrian (ru.pedestrian) moves at 1.4 m/s across a lane at right angles to the lane's st.lane_direction, footprint on the roadway and on no st.crosswalk, at a place declared asm.business_district true.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The same pedestrian crosses the same roadway with its footprint inside a st.crosswalk with marked true at every observation of the crossing, in a business district.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A pedestrian walks on a st.sidewalk and occupies no roadway, in a business district.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: A pedestrian is on the roadway outside any crosswalk in a business district; the source does not observe kin.velocity, so whether it moves across the lane is unknown.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The pedestrian crosses within an unmarked crosswalk (st.crosswalk with marked false) at an intersection, in a business district.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: The pedestrian crosses mid-block outside any crosswalk at a place declared asm.business_district false.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed quantisation of the acquisition standard's scene graph

param_proposals.name: p.crossing_motion_cos
param_proposals.convention: largest absolute cosine between a pedestrian's velocity and a carrier's designated direction at which the pedestrian counts as moving across the carrier rather than along it: motion more than about 20 degrees away from the direction of travel
param_proposals.source: pedestrian crossing-trajectory observation studies (FHWA pedestrian crossing behaviour)
